objective: Bring an Undamaged Venom Sac to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

description: I must have a fresh sample of the venom you brought me.  The spiders from which it was gathered must dwell in the Hinterlands -- hunt them until you find an undamaged venom sac and bring it to me.  You will find many spiders near the troll city of Shadra'Alor.
Do not tarry, <name>, for the venom sac must be fresh when you deliver it.
progress: Do you have the undamaged venom sac, <name>?  I yearn to run experiments with its fresh venom, and have ordered a collection of small, terribly cute animals on which to test it!
completion: Oh, splendid! The venom is quite fresh and I'm sure very deadly. Thank you!
